report_name: UCHealth Notifies 129,000 of Data Breach from Cloud Account Hack

attack_patterns.name: Cloud Accounts
attack_patterns.description: Unauthorized third parties gained access to two employee Microsoft cloud accounts using compromised credentials, which allowed them to access sensitive patient data.

attack_patterns.name: Email Forwarding Rule
attack_patterns.description: Attackers may create email forwarding rules in compromised cloud mailboxes to maintain persistence and monitor communications, as suggested by hunting hints for `Set-Mailbox -ForwardingSmtpAddress`.

identities.name: UCHealth
identities.description: A Colorado-based healthcare provider that suffered a data breach affecting approximately 129,000 patients due to the compromise of two employee cloud accounts.

indicators.name: Suspicious Microsoft Cloud Account Logon
indicators.pattern:
title: Suspicious Microsoft Cloud Account Logon
id: 2b8a1c3d-f4e5-4b6c-8d9a-0123456789ab
status: experimental
description: Detects suspicious sign-in activity to Microsoft cloud services, such as impossible travel or logins from anonymizing services, which could indicate an account takeover.
references:
  - https://openclassactions.com/news/data-breaches/uchealth-data-breach.php
author: cyber.netsecops.io
date: 2026-11-19
tags:
  - attack.t1078.004
level: high
logsource:
  product: azure
  service: signinlogs
detection:
  selection:
    RiskLevelDuringSignIn: 'high'
    ResultType: '0'
  condition: selection
indicators.description: Detects high-risk sign-ins to Azure AD / Microsoft 365 accounts, such as those indicative of impossible travel or logins from anonymizing proxies, which was a likely vector in the UCHealth breach.

indicators.name: Exchange Online Mailbox Forwarding Rule Creation
indicators.pattern:
title: Exchange Online Mailbox Forwarding Rule Creation
id: 9e8d7c6b-a5b4-4c3d-8e9f-ba9876543210
status: experimental
description: Detects the creation of an email forwarding rule on a mailbox, a common TTP for attackers to exfiltrate data and maintain persistence after an account compromise.
references:
  - https://openclassactions.com/news/data-breaches/uchealth-data-breach.php
author: cyber.netsecops.io
date: 2026-11-19
tags:
  - attack.t1114.003
level: high
logsource:
  product: m365
  service: audit.exchange
detection:
  selection:
    Operation: 'Set-Mailbox'
    Parameters.Name: 'ForwardingSmtpAddress'
  condition: selection
indicators.description: Detects the creation of email forwarding rules within Exchange Online, a common technique for data exfiltration and persistence following a cloud account compromise.

relationships.source_name: Exchange Online Mailbox Forwarding Rule Creation
